actions.description: Effect: If there is at least one other allied creature with the Plus, Cationic or Minus Ability on the field, the user can deploy a @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-summons.Item.bazH8BTCs3Jc3RAI]{Cationic Summon}, which grants +50% Defense to all allies with one of the corresponding abilities.

system.description:
Effect: If there is at least one other allied creature with the Plus, Cationic or Minus Ability on the field, the user can deploy a @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-summons.Item.bazH8BTCs3Jc3RAI]{Cationic Summon}, which grants +50% Defense to all allies with one of the corresponding abilities.

The Cationic Summon is terminated if the user is @Affliction[fainted] or removed from the field.
